payload.aggregation: Average five downstream seeds within each upstream seed, then mean and sample SD (ddof=1) across upstream seeds 1-5.
payload.ratio_definition: Mean and sample SD of same-number upstream-seed ratios to the selected original Transformer baseline: 75/25 for own_upstream, 100/0 for 100_0. This is not a ratio of grand means.
payload.supplementary_upstream_note: F2 paired upstream curves differ from the original 75/25 curve. They are recorded for auditing; all ratios use the selected original Transformer baseline, consistently with F1/F3. Absolute rejection is not rescaled.
